description: This file defines a Project entity class within the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_project' database table. It includes properties for project details such as ID, customer association, name, description, deletion status, and project administrators. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and includes methods for accessing and mutating these properties.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Entity class representing a project within the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_project' table. It manages project properties like ID, associated customer, name, description, deletion status, and administrators, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database interactions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier (project_id) of the project.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (project_id) of the project.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the Customer entity associated with this project.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a Customer entity with this project.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the project.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the project.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the project.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the project is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the project as deleted or active.

methods.name: getProjectAdmins
methods.description: Returns a collection of Employee entities who are administrators for this project.
